scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,frontend,node "npm run dev -w @agent/contracts" "npm run dev -w @agent/agent-frontend" "npm run dev -w @agent/node-agent"
scripts.dev:node: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @agent/node-agent
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @agent/node-agent && npm run build -w @agent/agent-frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
